item.title: City of Lawrence is poised for major growth, new mayor says
item.description: Mayor Brad Finkeldei said he believes downtown Lawrence will be transformed, the city will expand west of K-10 and more development is coming in the next year or two. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence City Commissioners Courtney, Polian sworn in, ask to revisit rec center fees
item.description: New Lawrence City Commissioners Mike Courtney and Kristine Polian, sworn in Tuesday, have asked to revisit fees the city plans to charge residents to access rec centers starting next month. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas to boost access to behavioral health care with share of $72M grant
item.description: State officials say Kansas' shift to 18th from last in the nation in an assessment of mental illness and access to behavioral health care is a direct outcome of investment in quality care. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas is one of the top hemp growing states, but a federal change threatens the industry
item.description: Kansas hemp growers and processors say a new, stricter federal law could derail the entire industry. The state has grown to one of the top five hemp producing states in the country. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Humane Pet of the Week: Forget White Fang – La Croix loves prancing in the snow, is house-trained
item.description: In spite of her rocky origins as an unclaimed stray, La Croix is a ray of sunshine in Lawrence's snow-ridden landscape. Continue reading ...

item.title: University of Kansas joins $3.7 million program to generate more special education doctorates
item.description: KU and two other public universities will collaborate on a $3.75 million federal grant to recruit master’s degree recipients into a collaborative doctoral program focused on special education leadership. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Beauty Brands to close later this month
item.description: Beauty Brands will permanently close later this month after nearly three decades in business in Lawrence. Continue reading ...

item.title: Douglas County seeks input via survey on trash, recycling and other waste management
item.description: Douglas County is requesting feedback on its management of trash, recycling, organics and other waste materials. Continue reading ...

item.title: Crafts, hobby horses and scavenger hunt at Watkins Museum to get kids in the holiday spirit
item.description: Although Lawrence’s Old-Fashioned Christmas Parade won’t take to the streets this year, the show will go on for the Watkins Museum’s accompanying Tails and Traditions Holiday Festival. Continue reading ...

item.title: ‘By hook or by crook,’ the Lawrence Public Library’s collections team gets books, materials in patrons’ hands
item.description: Even as the library world experiences turbulence with the closure of a major book distributor, the oft-unseen denizens of the Lawrence Public Library’s basement remain steady in delivering materials to their patrons. Continue reading ...
